title: CLIP THE BIAS: HOW USEFUL IS BALANCING DATA IN MULTIMODAL LEARNING?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring representation bias by comparing the probability parity of predicting 'man' versus 'woman' on general image datasets (e.g., ImageNet), and measuring association bias by calculating the absolute difference in probabilities of associating specific occupations with perceived men versus perceived women using datasets like FairFace, UTKFace, and MIAP.

Demonstrating the debiasing algorithm's capability in an empirical verification setup by balancing age group distributions and minimizing Pearson correlation scores between age and perceived gender/occupations.
